content:
Sophie (Customer Success): Heads up — acct 01234 (Acme Travel) says promo PRM-APR24 didn't apply to their April invoices. They're showing a $1,200 overcharge and asking for the promo to be applied + a goodwill refund. Can finance weigh in?
Maya (Finance): Can you paste the invoice IDs and the billing period? Also did they actually enter the promo at checkout or is this a support claim?
Sophie (Customer Success): Customer says they entered PRM-APR24 at signup and included screenshot. Invoices:
```
INV-2026-0041  (2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30)
INV-2026-0042  (adjust/overage line)
Promo code: PRM-APR24 (customer claim)
Amount disputed: $1,200
```
Jonas (Billing): I'll reconcile usage for acct 01234 for April. @billing-bot can you pull the usage and whether a promo was applied?
billing-bot: Fetched usage for acct 01234 (2026-04): total_tokens=12,345; base_charge=$1,234.50; promo_applied=false; invoice INV-2026-0041 shows no PRM-APR24 line.
Liam (Ops): If promo was valid we should apply retroactive promo and consider a goodwill credit. Is $1,200 the full invoice amount?
Sophie (Customer Success): Yes, they say the promo should have reduced it to ~$34 but it didn't. Customer is an enterprise pilot and threatens to pause usage. High churn risk.
Maya (Finance): Our policy: for confirmed promo-engine failures we do retroactive application. Goodwill depends on risk — standard is up to 25% or capped $500. For enterprise churn risk we can escalate. Need sign-off from Finance lead.
Sophie (Customer Success): Recommend full retro credit of $1,200 (promo + goodwill) given churn risk. They were a paying pilot.
Jonas (Billing): If approved I will run a manual adjustment. Example CLI I will use:
```
adjust_credit --acct 01234 --invoice INV-2026-0041 --amount 1200 --type manual_goodwill --note "Retroactive promo + goodwill refund per CS request; Zendesk Z-7345"
```
Maya (Finance): I approve this one-time manual_goodwill_refund for $1,200 given the churn risk. Tag GL code GWR-001 and set reason "promo engine failure". Please attach the customer's screenshot and email thread to the accounting ticket.
Jonas (Billing): Running adjustment now. Will paste txn id when complete.
billing-bot: Adjustment job queued. Processing...
billing-bot: Adjustment complete. TXN-789012. Invoice INV-2026-0041 balance updated to $0. Confirmation email queued to acct admin.
Sophie (Customer Success): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Please confirm this retro apply also marks PRM-APR24 as applied for audit. I'll follow up in Zendesk Z-7345 with the customer.
Liam (Ops): I'll run a sweep for other PRM-APR24 usages to make sure it's not a systemic issue. Will report findings by EOD.
Maya (Finance): Thanks — also please include a short note in the monthly billing exceptions log so we can track promo fallout.
Sophie (Customer Success): Noted, adding to Z-7345 and linking to billing exceptions.
